rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: And if Penacony should seize this opportunity to overcome adversity... Even if the IPC tries to intervene, every move we make will be scrutinized by trillions of people.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Ohohoho... now I'm convinced that you've indeed familiarized yourself with my biography, Miss Jade. So, about your next move... please consider it carefully.
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: Indeed, we need some time to digest such a wealth of information.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I suggest we conclude the first half of our conference, Mr. Alfalfa. Please allow Topaz and me to confer privately for a few moments and to respond on behalf of the IPC later.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Ohohoho, of course. Take your time, dear ladies.
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: It feels like I had a really long dream.
Even long dreams eventually come to an end. Our adventure in Penacony is reaching its conclusion.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Where is Himeko?
She went to negotiate with The Family as a representative of the Crew. She'll contact us once her arrangements are ready.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Please continue the topic.

After Ena's dream was shattered, The Family branch from the Montour System soon arrived and swiftly took control of the situation. Most members of the Oak Family fell unconscious, but fortunately, their lives were not in danger.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: And... what about Sunday?
He'll face a trial. As for further details... The Family would rather not disclose them.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: How did the guests react?

Since The Family branch from the Montour System managed to quash the spread of rumors within a short period of time, the majority of guests were unaware of the situation, and their lives remained largely unaffected.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: What will happen to Penacony?
That's what we're about to witness on the Radiant Feldspar.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Ultimately, the public perceived the incident as an attack by evil forces targeting the Charmony Festival. They believe The Family failed to safeguard the sweet dream, significantly eroding their credibility in the process.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hello again.
Yeah, it's good to see you all again, although we might be saying goodbye again after this reunion.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: How come you're here too?
What are you talking about? This is my lounge.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: When will the Astral Express leave Penacony?
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: What will happen to Sunday and Robin?
One bird longs for the earth, and the other longs for the sky... Even if Robin had to stop her brother with her own hands, she won't give up on him.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: When did the Order infiltrate Penacony?

Since The Family took up residence in Penacony, the Order has been hiding in plain sight under the guise of the Oak Family, using the Stellaron's power to strengthen their hold on the sweet dream, which eventually resulted in disaster.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Did the IPC make any move?
Aventurine's efforts finally earned the IPC a seat at the table. As a result, a more senior representative arrived in Penacony and initiated negotiations with The Family.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: What happened to you in Ena's dream?
Well, it was somewhat surprising. In that dream, I returned to my homeworld and reunited with my long-lost friends. And for some reason... Acheron resurfaced in my mind.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: That's all for now.
The conclusion of a journey can often be sorrowful. All we can do is try to make sure it ends on a happy note.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But what about the Express?
Given the conductor's presence, there's no need to worry about it. However, it's crucial that we soon return to inform Pom-Pom about uh... the Nameless.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What happened to you in Ena's dream?
In my dream, the Express stopped at many places, and passengers came and went. However, the five of us were always present, and the journey seemed never-ending.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is the Order incident in Penacony a unique case...?
No related records exist in the data bank, but I have a theory: The hidden dangers of the Order have always been within the Harmony — And this issue existed within The Family from the very beginning.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's all for now.
Like I said, we'll go and see. Once we've packed everything, we should head to our next destination.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Could it be a terrorist attack!?
But who would launch such an obvious attack? They just want to stir up chaos.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Did you press it?
Of course not! Who would press something like that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: By the time I turned around, the person had already vanished. So I handed it over to a nearby hound. I heard there were many similar reports before the Charmony Festival started.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We will.
Alright, enough with the heavy stuff. You guys have important things to take care of, so let's not dwell on things.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: But what if we never cross paths with him?
Then... I guess you won't be seeing him.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: The Alfalfa Family had a meeting with the IPC?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I got this information from a message sent by that {RUBY_B#Aventurine}IPC ambassador{RUBY_E#}. He said it was to "return the favor."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It's not hard to imagine. Penacony today is pretty much like the frontier prison it once was, with external forces casting greedy eyes and the undercurrent of Order lurking within.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Instead of falling into a situation where they are plagued by both external and internal threats, Penacony would rather take a step back and invite the IPC to negotiate at the table, ostensibly to cooperate, but in reality, to secure more opportunities for their own survival.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Well, no wonder they sought the mediation from the Astral Express. In your opinion, who should we stand behind?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I don't think the followers of the Harmony are completely innocent victims in all of this. For reasons unknown, they have a strong desire to smooth things over, which leads to speculation about their motives.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: If either The Family or IPC were to assume full control of Penacony, it would return to its previous illusory dream of hedonism, and the efforts of those previous Nameless... would once again go to waste.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: There you are. Did you rest well?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I didn't disturb you since you were in a deep sleep.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The mastermind behind the plans was confirmed to be Gopher Wood, the previous Dreammaster, but by the time we arrived... {RUBY_B#Crows}he{RUBY_E#} was dead already.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: While quite different from the truth, this appears to be the outcome with the least impact...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: After all, you don't know who's awake and who's pretending to be asleep. While they'll open their eyes in the face of danger, once the danger subsides, they'll embrace the sweet dream again.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Here's a toast, with three glasses of "Glory of the Trailblaze" to all of you.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: It's good to see you all again, although we might be saying goodbye again after this reunion.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: We'll stay a bit longer, but not too long.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: So, this is our final meeting, then? If this is a farewell, then it seems to be missing something.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Music? Atmosphere? Ah, maybe a special drink to honor those who are not here.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: Let's see. The mixed drink should be solemn, dignified, and unique, as we'll use it to pay respect to those fallen heroes...
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: To the Nameless resting in peace... and to Gallagher.
rows.speaker: Siobhan

rows.text: (Is that... Robin? She's also here, on the Radiant Feldspar.)
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Numby, catch!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Numby, catch!
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: ...Oink! Oink, oink!
rows.speaker: Numby

rows.text: Where's that prankster? Haven't the hounds caught him yet?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: What will happen if you press it? Hasn't anyone actually tried?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Anyway, The Family will deal with these things. Please kindly keep your distance.
rows.speaker: The Family's Guard

rows.text: You're not dreaming. We're in The Reverie Hotel, in the real world. The Order's dream is over.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What are you talking about? Are you still half-asleep or something...? The Order's dream is over.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, I was seriously worried when you didn't respond. Thank goodness. The Order's dream is over.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Even though it's been a day, I still break into a sweat when I think about it. Our Trailblazing expedition almost ended in Penacony...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Stellaron was sealed while you were sleeping. The ordinary people in Penacony have no idea what happened. They just feel like something is missing from their memories.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: They've already left, leaving this kindhearted girl to wake you up. You owe her big time.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: A natural beauty like me never has dark circles!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Old Oti is in agreement, so the issue is settled, I presume. What about the remaining family heads...?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: They will soon realize the situation. When the last question was asked, Old Oti represented more than just the Alfalfa Family.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: When should we schedule the formal negotiations? I'll handle the arrangements.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: It's all up to you. I'll step back and let you handle the negotiations and takeover. I won't be involved.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: But Miss Jade, this is...
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Aventurine initiated this case, and you were his project partner. If that kid hadn't overplayed his hand, I wouldn't have been pushed to the forefront.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I came here today to help you sort out the toughest issue. I trust you'll be able to wrap things up quite nicely, little Jelena.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Of course, there won't be any problems. And please, give Diamond my assurance.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Don't worry. Diamond has always trusted us. I'll put in a good word for you, and you'll have your P45 position back in no time.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Radiant Feldspar... what a fantastic ship. Now that my business is done, it's time for me to indulge in my own little hobby.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: You want to open a Bonajade Exchange branch on this ship, too?
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Opportunities like this don't come around often. Just look at the guests on this ship. They're surely holding a wealth of valuable treasures.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Well, I'll take my leave. A pawnshop can't run without a boss. See you around, Topaz.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I have one more question for you, Miss Jade.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: Hmm? Go ahead.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: That dose of "bitter poison"... I'm curious as to how you found this information.
rows.speaker: Topaz

rows.text: I didn't find the information. It came to me. It was from... a lady concerned with the future of the Harmony.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: In return, I've agreed to help her with something, but that's for later. We can deal with it after we leave Penacony.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: You see, that's what "investment" is all about. The seeds of opportunity are already sown, they only need a little bit of nourishment to take root. And then after, all we need to do is to wait patiently.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Like right now for example. It's just about time my final "guest" boarded the ship.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Heh, that's the brilliant part of it all. The answer is simple: No one. There are no guarantees. It all hinges on self-awareness and mutual respect. However, the board of directors will consider the interests of the family heads to some extent.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: You're a smart merchant, Old Oti. Isn't the whole purpose of this elaborate game to showcase your business acumen and seek more benefits for The Family?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: It benefits us if we both take a step back. And if that's not enough for you, I'm pretty sure that another goal of making Penacony go public is to expand the influence of the Planet of Festivities and attract more customers.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I understand your concern, and I have a solution for that, too.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Fine, now I see your sincerity. As the head of the Alfalfa Family, I don't think I have any reason to refuse your offer...
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: However, as {RUBY_B#Xipe, the Harmony}THEIR{RUBY_E#} chosen one, I still need one final answer.
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: Go ahead, I'm listening.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: When I was a child, I heard the adults recite the tale of the Ancient Amber Era, about the ascension of Xipe the Harmony, and the downfall of Ena the Order.
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: The Order and the Preservation used to be close in ancient times. So why does the IPC, as a follower of the Amber Lord, seek collaboration with The Family instead of aligning with the Order?
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: The answer is simpler than you think: It's all about credits, everyone's favorite thing and the universally recognized currency among the stars. The IPC has the power to perpetually ensure their value.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: With each new world integrated into the credit system, the IPC adds another building block to its cause. Eventually, all exchanges, capital, and businesses will operate within a unified monetary system.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: By then, all planetary developments will be recorded in accounts with well-defined values and the ability for exchange and circulation. And the heart of everything will be Qlipoth's "credit."
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: And then the IPC will be able to exert influence over everything.
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: Our intention is to establish enduring Preservation, so I'm sure you can understand...
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: This universe doesn't need two types of Order.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Ohoho! Well said! Now you've convinced me.
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: Alright, tell me your solution. Let's see if we're thinking the same thing.
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: Then let's continue our conversation. Please, Topaz, invite "Sweet Dew" to join us at the table.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Thank you for your presence, Miss Himeko.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Please allow me to introduce her to you, Mr. Alfalfa. This is Miss Himeko from the Astral Express, one of the future shareholders of Penacony!
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I've heard so much about you, Mr. Alfalfa. It's an honor to meet you as representative of the Astral Express.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Ohoho! This stunning lady is the navigator of the Astral Express? It's a pleasure to meet you.
rows.speaker: Old Oti

rows.text: I believe everyone here is familiar with the general contents of the proposal. After this round of financing, the IPC is expected to hold 30% of Penacony's shares.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Then, the IPC will transfer 5% of that stake to the Astral Express and recommend Miss Himeko as an independent director to honor the sacrifices and contributions made by the former Nameless to the Land of the Dreams.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: While this decision isn't finalized yet, we are honored that everyone here recognizes the way of the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: While the Nameless didn't embark on their journeys for fame or fortune, if this is the wish of both The Family and the IPC, I will represent the Astral Express and fulfill my duty as a member of the board of directors.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The entire Crew has agreed to assist in the reconstruction of Penacony. Beyond that, in our future travels, we are committed to bringing the beautiful dreams of the Planet of Festivities to more worlds.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Of course, all cooperation is based on one premise...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The Path of Harmony in Penacony must not be distorted again... and such a tragedy must never recur.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: After the negotiations...
(Lady Bonajade? I think I've heard that name somewhere before... Was it from Silver Wolf?)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Come to think of it, she disappeared after mentioning that she was going to meet with the Genius Society. I wonder how things turned out for her.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (No, it's not the best time to do that...)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Sorry, [Trailblazer], but I've got to find Lady Bonajade first.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (No, it's not the best time to do that...)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Sorry, [Trailblazer]. I'll catch up with you later.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (That Lady Bonajade feels more like a... moneylender rather than the owner of a pawnshop.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Well, I've got nothing better to do anyway. I'll do as she says and see what happens.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (All of their wishes actually did come true...)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (But I just don't understand. How did she do it? And what does "pawn" really mean? I should go back and ask...)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: If I win...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Your chest is mine!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Who said I was betting with you?
rows.speaker: Irritated Intellitron

rows.text: I did!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (They are still a ball of fire as ever.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Sorry, [Trailblazer], but I've got to find Lady Bonajade first.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Which one should I pop?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: One, two, three, four, five...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Dan Heng and Voidranger jive...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Don't change the words.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (No, it's not the best time to do that...)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Sorry, [Trailblazer]. I'll catch up with you later.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Chirp, chirp...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Origami bird... Hey, little birdie...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Come on...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come down already. Everyone's staring at you!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: (No, it's not the best time to do that...)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Sorry, [Trailblazer]. I'll catch up with you later.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: The Harmony needs a new direction. Only by bidding farewell to the past can we actually sail into the future.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: There are no permanent allies or everlasting enemies. So, let's both... take what we need from this deal.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Naturally. I'm looking forward to your performance. See you at the Festival.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: See you later, Miss Jade.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: A pawnshop that grants wishes...?
rows.speaker: Skeptical Pepeshi

rows.text: Nah, sounds too good to be true.
rows.speaker: Skeptical Pepeshi

rows.text: If they can really grant my wish...
rows.speaker: Naive Intellitron

rows.text: I wonder what they'll ask for in return?
rows.speaker: Naive Intellitron

rows.text: Hey, did you see that?
rows.speaker: Curious Woman

rows.text: The gray-haired one outside...
rows.speaker: Curious Woman

rows.text: Don't look around! Just focus on your drink!
rows.speaker: Careful Pepeshi

rows.text: Seriously, they look like a total lunatic...
rows.speaker: Careful Pepeshi

rows.text: Chirp, chirp...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Origami bird... Hey, little birdie...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Come on...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come down already. Everyone's staring at you!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If I win...

rows.text: Your chest is mine!

rows.speaker: Male Intellitron

rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Which one should I pop?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: One, two, three, four, five...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Dan Heng and Voidranger jive...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Have you been to the pawnshop?
rows.speaker: Envious Lady

rows.text: Yeah, sure.
rows.speaker: Frivolous Intellitron

rows.text: What did you pawn?
rows.speaker: Envious Lady

rows.text: Nothing, actually.
rows.speaker: Frivolous Intellitron

rows.text: Then why did you go there?
rows.speaker: Envious Lady

rows.text: Just to meet Lady Bonajade in person.
rows.speaker: Frivolous Intellitron

rows.text: ...Come on, you're all the same!
rows.speaker: Envious Lady

rows.text: So, you're back, Miss Samuel.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Yeah, I found those people, and it seems their wishes did come true after visiting the Bonajade Exchange.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: But I'm not sure what you want me to see. They all seem to be living... fulfilled lives.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Not so fast. This step was just to show you that the Bonajade Exchange is genuine, that I had the power to grant their wishes. And now, I'll tell you the price they paid.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Dell was from a wealthy family. He was head over heels for Dorothy and wanted to win her heart, so he made a deal with me. He put up his entire fortune in exchange for a gift that would impress Dorothy.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: It was a piece of cake for me, thanks to my IPC connections. However, Dell will soon find himself evicted from the Dreamscape because he can't afford his room. Whether he can bounce back from poverty... well, that depends on him.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Let's just hope that necklace will keep their relationship from crumbling.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Then there's Stacy, a lady with a gambling addiction. She wanted some serious luck, but she had nothing to offer, so I took something else instead. I took away all her close relationships.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: From the moment she stepped out of the Bonajade Exchange, every casino in the cosmos would remember her name, but her parents and siblings would sever ties with her, and it would be impossible for Stacy to make any real friends again.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: She will accrue a vast wealth due to her "good luck," but she'll never be able to use it for the people who truly matter to her.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: As for Detective Walker, he spent two decades chasing down a wanted criminal for some heinous crime, but he never caught the guy. In his desperation, he came to me.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: He offered his own memory system as collateral. In due time, his memories as a detective will be erased, and he will completely forget his own identity and all the sacrifices he has made.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Interesting, don't you think? I fulfill people's desires and grant them favors, and soon, they come back to me with even greater desires.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: When people see others' desires get fulfilled, they develop their own desires. It seems like an endless cycle but it does have a goal. In the end, I will get what I desire from this whirlpool.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: And patience happens to be one of my greatest strengths. So now, do you understand what you must give up, Miss Samuel? Or should I address you as...
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: (Is that... [Trailblazer]?)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (Sneaking in was easier than I thought. The Family's security is as lax as ever.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (So, this is the Radiant Feldspar... so luxurious.)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: (A pawnshop that grants wishes... is there really a place like that on this ship?)
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: AR-26710, a remnant of Glamoth's Iron Cavalry?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: ...I'm not surprised.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: You are much calmer than I expected. Entropy Loss Syndrome... truly an unjust misfortune, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: The higher-ups in Glamoth implemented such a "fail-safe" within the genes of their warriors, just to make sure the Republic's most powerful weapons wouldn't fall into the wrong hands.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: As for the price... Those Iron Cavalries weren't exactly seen as regular, independent "humans," so there wasn't really a price to be paid.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: However, you are different. You're now a Stellaron Hunter, a living being named Firefly. Naturally, you want to continue your existence, but with the Firmament Front gone, the people who know the secret and can cure the disease are nowhere to be found.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Are you suggesting that the IPC has a remedy?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Well, there might be a silver lining. That's all I can say for now.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I see. It's no wonder you said I can't provide anything of equal value, because nothing I own holds any meaning...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: So, you're going to ask me to personally restrain my partners to ensure my own survival.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Unfortunately, that's not quite the case.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Partners... a nice way to put it. Now, I'm even more curious about the Stellaron Hunters. Each of you has your own identity and a special bond with each other. It's strong and intimate, and yet it allows for independence.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Just as the Ten Stonehearts follow Diamond, you follow your own leader. I wonder what they are like, and if all Stellaron Hunters are like you...
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Traveling on the Path of Finality but struggling against your destiny, attempting to move in the opposite direction?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I really hope that one day, all of you will come and visit my pawnshop. I'll be waiting patiently for that day.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Can I see this as an invitation from Diamond to the Stellaron Hunters while keeping the IPC in the dark?
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Consider it more of a personal offer from myself. It doesn't represent the IPC or the Strategic Investment Department.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I'm not even a real bomb! Was it surprising, shocking, horrifying? No? Really? Fine. That's too bad then. You really ought to learn how to win a girl over!
rows.speaker: "Bomb Devil" Doll

rows.text: All right. Now that you've found me, it's my turn to complete my mission. Next, I'll count down from five, and then explode!
rows.speaker: "Constable" Doll

rows.text: Five...
rows.speaker: "Constable" Doll

rows.text: Four...
rows.speaker: "Constable" Doll

rows.text: One...!
rows.speaker: "Constable" Doll

rows.text: Was it surprising, shocking, horrifying? No? Really? Fine. That's too bad then. You really ought to learn how to win a girl over!
rows.speaker: "Constable" Doll

rows.text: Oh, by the Laughter, to think you've seen through my disguise this quickly! Honestly, my dear {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Gray Hair, you're just like that ferocious pangolin in Madam Susan's bedroom!
rows.speaker: "Sheriff" Doll

rows.text: This evil city has fallen into depravity! As the Sheriff Doll, I cannot idly stand by and do nothing! And now, only this imaginary neutron bomb can completely cleanse Sparkle City of your ilk!
rows.speaker: "Sheriff" Doll

rows.text: If you wish to defeat me, you'll have to face off against the great Sparkle's dogs — they're my fiercely loyal companions, and you'll never defeat them!
rows.speaker: "Sheriff" Doll

rows.text: To think I was defeated by the despicable underling of Blazin' Bro... You'll never get away with this. Because I'm just an adorable doll, not some imaginary neutron bomb!
rows.speaker: "Sheriff" Doll

rows.text: The "Sheriff" doll lets out a long sigh and, with its exquisite acting, feigns death. Unfortunately, the imaginary neutron bomb isn't here, it's best to look elsewhere.
Ha, we meet again, [Trailblazer]. I am Penacony's famed detective.
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: Got yourself into a pickle? I'm more than happy to help, but unfortunately, I'm preoccupied with a couple of unsolved cases... So, you'll have to wait your turn.
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: I need your help, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]. You've had quite a few run-ins with Dr. Boom, and with the recent bomb situation, you're bound to find evidence that proves Dr. Boom is the killer.
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: The first case is the SoulGlad factory arson case. We found a hammer, a doll and half a liter of an unidentified fluid at the scene of the crime. Our forensics results showed it's a red herring.
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: The second case is the Blue Hour auction robbery. A gang of masked thugs broke in, stole a fragment of the Astral Express, and left behind a large hammer, a doll, and a half-dead red herring at the scene.
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: Those are all the details. The way I see it, there must be a link between these two cases that will be key to exposing Dr. Boom.
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: I trust in your deduction. Which piece of evidence do you think is the deciding one?
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: Oh Gray Hair, Gray Hair, it's been so long, but you haven't changed at all. I'm sorely disappointed...
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: But, seeing as you've put in so much effort, I'll throw you a bone: The bomb's not here. This is only a prank I've craftily set up. Hurry, time's running out. You'd better find that real bomb quickly!
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: Seeing as you've put in so much effort, I'll throw you a bone: The bomb's not here, this is only a prank I've craftily set up. Hurry, time's running out. You'd better find that real bomb quickly!
rows.speaker: "Detective" Doll

rows.text: Welcome, human. I am an Aeonic Intelligence {RUBY_B#Nous}Droidhead{RUBY_E#} answering machine, also very likely an imaginary neutron bomb.
rows.speaker: "Trashcan" Doll

rows.text: If you can answer the only question I have for you correctly, you can open up my lid to check if I'm really a bomb or not. If I am, I will initiate my automated shutdown sequence to avert danger.
rows.speaker: "Trashcan" Doll

rows.text: I hate smartypants!
rows.speaker: "Trashcan" Doll

rows.text: You have passed the trial of the "Trashcan" doll. As expected, a doll that looks like Sparkle lies at the bottom of the can. Regrettably, it is nothing more than a clump of cotton, devoid of any projectile or aggregative firing devices and their combinations.
Hello, I'm a bomb! There's still some time before I explode, so you can take a look around first!
rows.speaker: "Fool" Doll

rows.text: ...Oh, hang on, Penacony's Family have not purchased the rights to this song — we can't play it here. How about this, I'll recite it for you — next up, please enjoy a recital of Never Give Up, Never Surrender!
rows.speaker: "Fool" Doll

rows.text: "O Aha! If you ask me how I feel about you, don't tell me that you pretend not to see!"
rows.speaker: "Fool" Doll

rows.text: "THEY will never give you up, never make you sad! THEY will never give you up, never make you cry!"
rows.speaker: "Fool" Doll

rows.text: "THEY will never say goodbye to you, never tell lies to hurt you — praise Aha!"
rows.speaker: "Fool" Doll

rows.text: After the almost-tearful exclamation of "Praise Aha!" comes to pass, all that's left in the doll's mouth are those lingering echoes of an irritating cassette tape. Turns out that it isn't a bomb after all, but a vintage tape recorder.
Welcome to the Radiant Feldspar, good {F#lady}{M#sir}! I am a dangerous bomb, and an outlaw who despises law and order. May you have a splendid day!
rows.speaker: "Outlaw" Doll

rows.text: Care to experience it? I can chant it for you, but Miss Sparkle won't be responsible for any of the consequences.
rows.speaker: "Outlaw" Doll

rows.text: Bloomska, boomska, little sparkleeesss!!! Bloomska, boomska, little sparkleeesss!!!
rows.speaker: "Outlaw" Doll

rows.text: The striking resemblance to the voice of the legendary Penaconian cartoon character "Clockie" instantly rings an alarm within you! The profound muscle memory from ancient times prompts you to swing your arms in a wide arc, catapulting the doll into the heavens.
If the doll's words just now are not false, then indeed there won't be an imaginary neutron bomb exploding on the surface at Golden Hour. No need to worry...?
Hello, lovely actor. You can call me the Director Doll. I often use this name in film credits.
rows.speaker: "Director" Doll

rows.text: If you didn't know, I'm the one who directed the entire farce in Penacony. As the leading {F#lady}{M#man} of the show, what did you think? Feel free to share your thoughts...
rows.speaker: "Director" Doll

rows.text: ...Well, actually, due to current plot requirements, you're only allowed to say one line. So, please try and resist the urge to share your thoughts.
rows.speaker: "Director" Doll

rows.text: ...Who knew that there was no such thing as the "Film Directing and Screenwriting program" at Sparkle University — in fact, Sparkle University isn't even real! Bah, Sparkle.
rows.speaker: "Director" Doll

rows.text: But don't fret! I've also prepared a gift for you — a dream bubble that has the thrilling life-and-death moments I shared with a beautiful Memokeeper! If you haven't seen it yet, you should hurry up and look for Dr. Edward.
rows.speaker: "Director" Doll

rows.text: The harmless chatterbox plush doll bows affectionately to you, blowing you a kiss before bounding away, vanishing into the depths of the cabin with joyful leaps.
Distinguished guests, fellow Family members, ladies, gentlemen and friends from all over the cosmos —
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: It's a pleasure to join you all in celebrating the grandest ceremony of the Amber Era, the Charmony Festival. Firstly, on behalf of the Penacony Family's five major lineages...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: And on behalf... of myself, I'd like to extend a warm welcome to all our guests!
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: As you all may have noticed, this year's Charmony Festival is far from regular. Thanks to the efforts of everyone, this celebration is unprecedented in scale, with factions from across the cosmos in attendance...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Not only that, the customary opening ceremony held at the Penacony Grand Theater has now moved to the Radiant Feldspar — the very airship you all stand upon.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: We invite you to express your warmest applause and deepest appreciation for Oti Alfalfa — head of the Alfalfa Family — for his selfless devotion to the Harmony's cause!
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: What makes this festival so uniquely significant? As is widely known, the Radiant Feldspar had to halt its voyage due to an anomaly in the sweet dream, sparking widespread discussion in the Twelve Hours...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: But thanks to the hard work of Penacony's internal and external factions, we've finally gotten the Dreamscape back on track, just in time for the Charmony Festival. And as they say, good things come in pairs. The Charmony Festival not only celebrates this achievement but also marks the relaunch of the Radiant Feldspar.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: And finally, the last reason. Does everyone remember the Watchmaker? In truth, The Family has poured their efforts into this festival just to commemorate this legendary luminary...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: The father of Penacony, Mikhail Char Legwork, one of the legendary Nameless who laid the foundations of Penacony!
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: In the most bewildering times of the Planet of Festivities, it was he who descended from the sky with his companions, who taught us through Trailblazing where freedom lies. It was also they who led the vanguard in the pioneering of the Dreamscape, in exchange for what is now known as the paradise of Harmony.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: It can be said that Penacony's splendid success today is deeply rooted in the Trailblazing ethos the Watchmaker planted within us. Only by honoring this Trailblazing spirit can we fulfill our mission and spread Harmony to a broader audience.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Aww... That's so nice of her. She's talking about us!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thus, with unanimous consent from the five major lineages, Penacony's Family — on behalf of all family members throughout the cosmos, offer a token of appreciation to the Nameless.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Oooh... I wonder if it's gonna be a big one?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...We will transfer ownership of the Radiant Feldspar to the Astral Express! A meager appreciation that we hope you will accept with grace.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Let us gift our applause and cheers to these brave and dauntless Nameless!
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Nameless! Nameless! Nameless!
rows.speaker: Guests

rows.text: And now, I propose a toast...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: To Harmony, to the Trailblaze, to the future of Penacony and the universe, and to the generous Alfalfa Family Head, Mr. Oti Alfalfa...
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: ...Cheers!
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: Actually... there might be another way.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Do you still remember? The script said that I will experience "death" three times in the Land of Dreams.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I think this moment heralds the third time.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: As long as I can bear the pain of the memoria pressure, I'll be able to dive into the primal Memory Zone beyond the dream, and extend a lifeline to the Radiant Feldspar.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I will take this bomb into {RUBY_B#Primordial Memory Zone}the depths of the Dreamscape{RUBY_E#}... as deep as possible, where there are no living souls around. That way, at least no one will get hurt.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: At present, this is our best, and most logical course of action. After all, a long story deserves a happy ending.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: I have some words to share with you, though they were spoken to me by Miss Acheron. She said that "The so-called impossible is merely something that has yet to happen..."
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: At the moment, there are so many things that seem impossible... but are they really never going to happen? Maybe it's just that the moment to disprove these "impossibilities" hasn't arrived yet.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Whether it be a literal ending, suffering akin to death, or a harrowing deathscape... Before the appointed destination arrives, they are all the same, yet I can still make myriad choices. I also firmly believe that...
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: That when that moment arrives for us to make a choice, the answer to our end will already be within our hearts.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: It is not destiny that shapes us, but we who shape destiny.
rows.speaker: Firefly

rows.text: Come to think of it, I didn't even get a chance to formally introduce myself...
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: The ocean of stars is vast, and given our destinations, I'm afraid our paths may not cross again.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Ah... In that case, I must apologize for my rudeness. Do you remember when we first met? I once said you reminded me of an acquaintance.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: We both still have our own paths to walk. So let's forge ahead. Hopefully, if we meet again... it'll be beneath clear skies.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: What do you mean? It's improbable that you've crossed paths with my past self... What I mean is, there is nothing left to retrace there — only Nihility.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That's right. What matters more is not who I am but what we have done together. This story... will be forever etched in my heart.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I see... You've also had a similar experience? Then you should know that this me and your memory of me are not the same person.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: That is true. Our memories make us who we are, and all memories originate from the "now." As for the future... it's already taking root in the now, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: ...Haha.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Yes, I understand. Cherish this moment, for it can help you remember the path you've traveled.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Hey, you're finally back!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: How could you say that! Don't be so mean. And while you're here, why don't you help me comfort Pom-Pom!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: *sob*... The con... conductor never cries! Pom-Pom... is never sad!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Well, they were a little emotional at the time, but... I'm afraid that's not out of the question.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: When you put it like that, it doesn't actually sound too bad.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...How about we shove you back in the space station's computer, then?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Which also means that we must prudently consider our next destination.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It is my honor. I've said many goodbyes. Yet I am glad, that this is the first time I speak those words with a smile.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Looks like you've also noticed that history fictionologist is nowhere to be found in Penacony, disappearing just as quietly as when he first showed up.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: A fitting end to the tale of the departed — one could not ask for a better farewell. Go on, they're all here.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I know, but the thing that I can't get out of my mind... is the present.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yeah, maybe that's the precise thing I can't let go of...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's rare that I'm this serious, can't you just humor me for once? Sheesh!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It'll be easier to understand if I use an analogy: Like when you're reading a book, if one of its characters keeps running into obstacles, and experiences an ending full of regrets, we're bound to feel a bit mixed about it, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Because we've seen every nook and cranny of their lives, we see these people as special.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Because we've seen every nook and cranny of their lives, we see these people as special.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: To me, it's because we've seen every nook and cranny of their lives, we see these people as special.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So even if there are parts of it that aren't really realistic nor logical, we still hope that their story gets a good ending when it comes.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Attachment, desire, longing... They may all be right, but they are all incomplete.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Memokeeper... Let's put aside how you managed to sneak past everyone and board the Express for now — you mentioned a suggestion...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: *sob*... *sniff*...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: There there... Chin up, Pom-Pom! Don't be sad. Don't cry...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wow, your method of consolation is truly unsophisticated.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Still better than just standing there like a scarecrow!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We told Pom-Pom all about our adventure, and... they suddenly started crying... I've never seen Pom-Pom so sad before...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We told Pom-Pom all about our adventure, and... they suddenly started crying... I've never seen Pom-Pom so sad before...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Pom-Pom is just... just...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: ...Just angry. Yeah, angry!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: No matter where the Express stops, you lot always manage to cause chaos! My well-thought-out timetable? Completely ignored! If you carry on like this, the Express is going to run out of fuel!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: That's right. Pom-Pom is just angry... It's not because of Misha, Tiernan, Razalina and the rest...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: ...Bwaahhh!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: It's okay. Pom-Pom, just let it all out.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Everyone, could you all take a break in the next car? Don't worry, I'll stay here with Pom-Pom.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's go, March.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I never expected Pom-Pom would be so distraught...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Those three Nameless must have meant a lot to Pom-Pom.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No one knows exactly when Pom-Pom boarded the Express, but one can surmise that their journey has been filled with many hellos and goodbyes, probably more than we can imagine.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The fact that they're crying so hard is probably a good sign. It proves that Pom-Pom's emotions haven't become dulled by the grind of time — they still deeply cherish every Nameless who has boarded the Express and value every journey shared with them.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Leave it to Himeko. When it comes to comforting, there's no one better on the Express.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Since [Trailblazer] joined us, the Express has stayed longer than anticipated at every stop along the way. And to ensure that everyone always makes it back on board, Pom-Pom has had no choice but to delay the warp jump schedule.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I see... No wonder I can regularly hear Pom-Pom pacing anxiously up and down the corridor.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Turns out, Pom-Pom's been silently putting in a lot of work for us, wow...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Different from typical vehicles, the Astral Express converts every "Trailblaze" into the energy it needs to run. Ideally, as long as trailblazing expeditions continue without interruption, the Express will receive a constant flow of energy, much like a perpetual motion machine.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But because of our previous encounters... fuel is being used up much faster than expected. We can probably only pull off two more warp jumps at most.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Only two more... Isn't that super risky? Ahh! I don't wanna become an ice cube floating around in space again!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But I don't even wanna become an adorable ice cube floating around in space again!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes. I've already checked the astral charts — the two nearest worlds to us are the oceanic planet of Lushaka and the Agate World, Melustanin.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: As for which one we're headed to, that still requires a vote...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...Or, perhaps you might consider a suggestion.
I hope I'm not too late, child.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: ...I wasn't expecting it to be you.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Don't you know how many sentry posts The Family has built, and how hard it is to get you out of here?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Looks like my time's up?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: What do you mean... What "time?"
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Negotiation, interrogation, or death... My fate lies entirely in your hands, Lady Bonajade.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: The dance is done. Why bother with the compassionate pretense and give someone who's about to die the chance to talk?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Despite your fall from grace, you still look well. I'm very glad to see that you're so full of verve.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Do not insult my pride with half-veiled sarcasm. Have you specially come to see me just to sate your vile vanity?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Of course not. I merely came to fulfill your younger sister's wishes. To offer you a generous trade — that is, if you're willing to accept.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Robin...?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: To build a true haven where everyone can attain peace — that's the oath between you siblings, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: If I told you there was still a chance to realize this vow... would you be willing to talk to me then?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I recognize the gravity of this question, which is why you don't have to answer me right now.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Go now. You are free — O chosen one, who dared to exceed his bounds. Sever your wings, descend to the mortal realm, and walk their lands. See what this world is truly like.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: I will not accept your charity.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: As I mentioned earlier: It's a trade, and you don't have to give me an answer right now. Rewards are not reaped in a day, and if there's one thing I'm best at, it's waiting. The sweet dream still continues, and the night is still long — you have plenty of time to contemplate your answer.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Ah, a word of advice for you before we part ways — a word of warning from someone who's been in your shoes before...
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Life is too short to miss out on golden opportunities.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: When I arrived, I happened to see a child holding it. He said the flowers were prepared by Aunt Jessie, for the Watchmaker, and the war comrade he'd missed his whole life.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Mikhail would place two bunches of flowers here year after year. And, after he left, it became three.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Your wishes will always be remembered by someone.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Now, Penacony as you hoped, has welcomed the dawn after a long, dark night. The path forward may not be a bed of roses, but at least people are prepared to step forth towards freedom.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: Tiernan, you can go home now.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: While the Nameless are also preparing for the next stop of their voyage.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: But before leaving, we still have one last thing to do.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But before leaving, I'm sure you all have plenty to say to the Nameless of the past?
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: I believe he must have come here at the end, to bid farewell to his Nameless friends. Similarly, I'm sure you all have plenty you want to say to them.
rows.speaker: Acheron

rows.text: With that, our duty as Nameless should be complete... right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Trailblaze can illuminate the way, but ultimately, the future of a world belongs to those who live in it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...I still feel that Mr. Mikhail must have really wanted to witness this day himself.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What's on your mind, March?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Just a strange feeling. I had it a few stops ago, but it's super strong this time.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Why not talk about it? Maybe everyone's thinking the same thing?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...I can't help but think that whether it's Mr. Mikhail, Mr. Tiernan, or Madam Razalina, their lives must have been long, and they must have experienced plenty of stories...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: They were also young once, stumbling and bumbling around just like us, getting into scraps and mischief, that sort of stuff. Companions, enemies, journeys, adventures, all the sad and happy memories... The "every day" that we're used to, they've lived through them too.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But those things... are all in the past.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But what if they... and we... aren't really that special?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When Mr. Mikhail sat in this chair, waiting for the Astral Express to arrive every day, what was he thinking? And if, at the end of his life, he could still firmly say he had no regrets...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Then, what is this regret we feel in our hearts right now...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I think, each and every one of us is searching for the answer to this very question.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The universe is vast, and our lives are but specks. The Trailblaze never ends, but against the backdrop of the cosmos, the average person's lifelong journey is merely a short stretch.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But it is in this miniscule distance that paths cross, and countless worlds connect. The universe may not remember every person who leaves a tie along the silver rail, but we will.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: As long as we remember, their {RUBY_B#The Trailblaze}stories{RUBY_E#} will never end.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: And what Mr. Mikhail has left for us is his answer to this very question. It may not be perfect, but it left a smile on this storied, jaded old Nameless' face at the end of his life.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: And its meaning will be interpreted by those who come after — us.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It's not the answer that's important, but what we can learn from others' answers... right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This is what Trailblazing is.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Sure.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm really sorry for bringing down the vibe! Quick, Dan Heng, tell us a dad joke to lighten the mood!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's never a bad thing to reflect. One day, we'll all have to face our own farewells.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But before that, we still have a long way ahead of us together.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So the most important thing right now is to tell the conductor what we saw in Penacony.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Then prepare ourselves for our next Trailblazing destination.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Everyone, we meet again.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I—It's you? Why were you just in my room...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's a very cute room, Miss March... just like you.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I accidentally overheard how the Express obtains fuel.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I just wanted to chat with everyone to see if we could work together, but now, it appears my suggestion could be the very lifeline that saves everyone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Please speak candidly. Depending on what you say, we could very well ask you to disembark.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ah, the Permanence's descendant... What a charming little dragon, especially with those mired memories of yours.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But I digress. If the Astral Express is in urgent need of a special trailblazing expedition to recharge its engine...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Have you all considered this? Perhaps your destination could be a world that even the renowned Akivili never reached...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Should you be able to lay down a new stretch of silver rail, the Express may never have to worry about energy ever again.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Trailblazing to a world that even Akivili has never been to... Is that possible?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Continue, Memokeeper. This destination of which you speak, what sort of world is it?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: A world that many across the universe don't even know exists...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: A world hidden away from outside observation, its presence only revealed by the light from the mirror of the Garden of Recollection...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: A world fettered by three Paths, its destiny hanging in the balance...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: The Eternal Land, Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Black Swan
